title: Apple AI glasses are set for 2027 debut, report claims
content_html:
Everyone is getting in on the smart glasses arms race, including Apple, apparently.

Mark Gurman at Bloomberg has a new report on Apple's planned entry into the smart glasses market, a move that has been rumored for some time. According to Gurman, Apple will unveil the device at next year's Worldwide Developers Conference, a nominally software-focused event Apple holds every June. Presumably, the glasses would then be available for purchase sometime before the end of 2027.

It's still unclear exactly what form Apple's glasses would take. Meta and Samsung, among others, have created a template in recent years for glasses that include cameras for photography and video, and for showing the world to an onboard AI assistant, but that obviously comes with plenty of privacy concerns. Gurman said Apple is mulling over removing cameras entirely or removing the ability to take photos and videos, with the cameras serving solely to provide context for an AI assistant.

The glasses will also reportedly not include any displays, which has been true of most existing smart glasses to date.

After the fairly resounding failure of Apple Vision Pro, it would have been reasonable to think that Apple would hold off on releasing any more face-worn devices for a while, but evidently not.

content_html_zh:
每个人都在参与智能眼镜军备竞赛，显然包括苹果。

彭博社的马克·古尔曼 (Mark Gurman) 发布了一份关于苹果计划进入智能眼镜市场的新报告，这一举措的传闻已经有一段时间了。 据 Gurman 称，苹果将在明年的全球开发者大会上推出该设备，该大会名义上是苹果每年六月举办的以软件为重点的活动。 据推测，这款眼镜将在 2027 年底之前上市。

目前还不清楚苹果眼镜具体会采用什么形式。 近年来，Meta 和三星等公司为眼镜创建了一个模板，其中包括用于摄影和视频的相机，以及用于向机载人工智能助手展示世界的眼镜，但这显然会带来很多隐私问题。 古尔曼表示，苹果正在考虑完全取消摄像头或取消拍摄照片和视频的功能，摄像头仅用于为人工智能助手提供背景信息。

据报道，该眼镜还将不包括任何显示屏，迄今为止大多数现有的智能眼镜都是如此。

在 Apple Vision Pro 惨遭失败之后，人们有理由认为苹果会暂时推迟发布任何更多的面部佩戴设备，但事实显然并非如此。
